subSpec.rule: a sub-spec feature is used only after the connection scope declares it; an undeclared optional capability is never assumed to be present

supportMatrix.description: the MetaFramer ASGI app served directly by Uvicorn
the same MetaFramer ASGI app served directly by Hypercorn
MetaFramer hosted or mounted inside a FastAPI application, served by Uvicorn
MetaFramer hosted or mounted inside a FastAPI application, served by Hypercorn
MetaFramer mounts an isolated FastAPI app without surrendering Domain or Application ownership
a FastAPI adapter calls the one MetaFramer Action Pipeline and reaches business work no other way

servers.reason: first supported server: ASGI focus, published deployment documentation and ecosystem fit make it the reference the conformance matrix is written against
an independent second implementation is what makes server substitutability testable; it is never the default and never a second semantic runtime

actionPipeline.rule: every route that reaches business work calls the one MetaFramer Action Pipeline; there is no alternate FastAPI, Hypercorn or Uvicorn business path

outcomeEquality.statement: The same CRM or HRMS form action must produce the identical business outcome across all four mandatory combinations, dimension by dimension. Uvicorn accepting the transport while Hypercorn rejects the business transaction is an architecture defect, not a documented difference.

optionalCapabilityAbsent.rule: when an optional capability is absent the deterministic standard fallback runs and every one of the nine dimensions stays identical

requiredTransportCapabilityAbsent.rule: a missing required transport capability disables the least-scope endpoint, service or module at startup with an explicit configuration error naming the capability; unrelated user forms are never rejected non-deterministically at request time

innerRingImportBan.enforcementObligation: the import-level fitness function that makes this ban build-failing is a separate package; this record does not claim enforcement it does not have

nodeBaseline.rule: the Node surfaces stay the frozen conformance reference until parity and cutover are separately proved in their own package

mcp.futureContract: a future MCP surface is a transport consumer at the Delivery boundary: it calls the same single MetaFramer Action Pipeline, decides nothing, holds no invariant and is bound by this same conformance matrix

canonicalKernelLanguageDecision.note: the P01-W1 S2 language decision stays open and unaccepted; this record selects no canonical kernel language and must never be read as having accepted or rewritten it

evidence.populariteKanitDegil: the claim rests on the published specification text and on independent implementations of it, never on stars, downloads or survey trend
evidence.bagimsizUretimKullanimi: interoperability evidence only: independent maintainers ship independent conforming servers against the same specification. A protocol specification is deliberately not presented as an organization-use production testimonial, so this dimension stays unproved
evidence.aktifBakimVeGuvenlikYaniti: the specification is versioned and maintained in the open, and the HTTP/WebSocket sub-spec carries its own version number, currently up to 2.5
evidence.performansVeOperasyonKaniti: not directly established: a specification defines an interface, and measured performance and operational experience belong to its implementations, so this dimension stays unproved here
evidence.standartBirlikteCalisabilirlik: the strongest dimension: ASGI is the open interface contract itself, so any conforming server is substitutable for any other
evidence.saglayiciBagimsizligi: no single vendor owns the interface; it is a published open specification with public documentation
evidence.cikisVeRollbackStratejisi: exit is the profile boundary itself: Application and Domain never import a server or a framework, so an implementation is replaced without touching business semantics

evidence.populariteKanitDegil: default-reference status rests on documented ASGI focus, published deployment documentation and a public release history, never on download counts
evidence.bagimsizUretimKullanimi: not directly established for the server itself: no server-specific independent multi-organization production evidence is recorded here, and FastAPI's organization statements are deliberately not transferred to Uvicorn
evidence.aktifBakimVeGuvenlikYaniti: a public, dated release stream with an open issue and pull-request flow
evidence.performansVeOperasyonKaniti: official deployment documentation covers process management, workers, proxies and TLS termination; independently measured load figures are not claimed here
evidence.standartBirlikteCalisabilirlik: a documented ASGI implementation, substitutable with any other conforming server under the same Core Profile
evidence.saglayiciBagimsizligi: open source and community maintained; no commercial dependency is required to run it
evidence.cikisVeRollbackStratejisi: replaced by any server that passes the same conformance matrix; no Uvicorn type is imported by Domain or Application, so the swap does not reach business semantics

evidence.populariteKanitDegil: support rests on published HTTP/2 and alternate worker documentation and a public release history, not on popularity
evidence.bagimsizUretimKullanimi: not directly established: no independent multi-organization global-scale production evidence is recorded here, which is exactly why it stays a conformance and portability target and never becomes a mandatory semantic dependency
evidence.aktifBakimVeGuvenlikYaniti: a public, dated release stream with an open issue and pull-request flow
evidence.performansVeOperasyonKaniti: official documentation records HTTP/2 support and alternate worker and event-loop options; independently measured load figures are not claimed here
evidence.standartBirlikteCalisabilirlik: a second independent implementation is the portability proof: it is what makes server substitutability testable rather than merely asserted
evidence.saglayiciBagimsizligi: open source and community maintained, independent of the default reference server's maintainers, which is the reason for keeping it
evidence.cikisVeRollbackStratejisi: dropping it removes conformance rows and nothing else; no business semantics depend on it, because it never owns any

evidence.populariteKanitDegil: the record rests on the named production statements published on the official site and on the public release stream, not on stars or downloads
evidence.bagimsizUretimKullanimi: the official site publishes production statements from independent organizations including Microsoft, Uber, Netflix and Cisco; this is organization-level evidence for the framework only and does not transfer to any server
evidence.aktifBakimVeGuvenlikYaniti: a public, dated release stream with an open issue and pull-request flow
evidence.performansVeOperasyonKaniti: not directly established here: no independently measured load figure and no incident or postmortem evidence is recorded, so this dimension stays unproved
evidence.standartBirlikteCalisabilirlik: FastAPI is itself an ASGI application, so it composes with MetaFramer at the same ASGI boundary in both directions, as host and as mounted app
evidence.saglayiciBagimsizligi: open source and community maintained; MetaFramer additionally keeps it optional, so the exposure is bounded by the adapter boundary
evidence.cikisVeRollbackStratejisi: removing it removes an adapter host and the two supplemental rows; the public developer API, Domain and Application are untouched because they never import it

manifestPointer.scope: one minimal root-level scoped pointer; the platform workspace stack.backend list is not rewritten by this package

capabilityDeltaSadeTurkce: Bu paket çalışan üründe yeni bir şey açmadı; yalnız kuralı, sözleşmeyi ve kanıtı yazılı ve denetlenebilir hâle getirdi. Kullanıcı ekranında bugün hiçbir şey değişmez.

ownerComprehension.once: Önce yazılı ve denetlenebilir tek bir sözleşme yoktu: MetaFramer'ın hangi taşıma katmanına ait olduğu, FastAPI'nin zorunlu mu isteğe bağlı mı olduğu ve aynı CRM veya HRMS form eyleminin farklı sunucularda aynı sonucu verip vermeyeceği garanti altında değildi.
ownerComprehension.simdi: Şimdi ASGI 3 Core Profile'ın MetaFramer'a ait olduğu, Uvicorn'un varsayılan referans, Hypercorn'un uyumluluk alternatifi ve FastAPI'nin isteğe bağlı adaptör konağı olduğu; her iş yolunun tek MetaFramer Action Pipeline'ını çağırdığı ve dört zorunlu kombinasyonun dokuz iş sonucu boyutunda aynı olması gerektiği yazılı ve makineyle denetlenebilir.
ownerComprehension.fark: Bir önceki aşamaya göre gerçek fark, bu kararın konuşma ve dağınık metin olmaktan çıkıp fail-closed bir doğrulayıcıya bağlanmasıdır; çalışan üründe yeni bir yetenek açılmadı.
ownerComprehension.kullaniciYolculugu: Bu paket bir CRM veya HRMS formunu henüz çalışır hâle getirmez; kaydettiği şey gelecekteki eşitlik sözleşmesidir. Kullanıcı formu gönderdiğinde istek yetkilendirildi mi, işlendi mi ve her seferinde aynı şekilde mi kaydedildi sorusunun cevabı, sunucu Uvicorn da olsa Hypercorn da olsa, FastAPI ile barındırılsa da barındırılmasa da aynı olmak zorundadır.
ownerComprehension.kalanEngel: Delivery halkası hâlâ kapalıdır ve bu kayıt onu açmaz; runtime implementasyonu başlamamıştır, iç halka import yasağı bugün derleme ile zorlanamaz, dört kombinasyonlu uyumluluk süiti ayrı bir pakettir ve kanonik kernel dili kararı açık kalır.

nonGoals: do not read this record as runtime implementation, readiness, release, deploy, app-buildable or production authorisation; it authorises governance, projection and test planning only
do not read it as accepting the open P01-W1 S2 language decision or as selecting a canonical kernel language
do not make Hypercorn the default or a second semantic runtime, and do not make FastAPI a required kernel dependency or the owner of the public developer API, Domain or Application semantics
do not branch business semantics on a server name, permit a permanent dual runtime or a dual write, or let an optional-capability fallback change a business outcome
do not extract source from, prove parity against, cut over from or unfreeze the Node conformance reference
do not invent an MCP config, server, tool or consumer; none exists today and the word alone is not a reason to create one
do not rewrite the current platform backend stack, any generated node, any sealed authority or promotion record, or any historical decision
do not stage, commit, push, tag, merge or otherwise mutate Git from this shard

rollback.trigger: the support matrix, an ownership pin, the nine outcome dimensions, the capability policy, the inner-ring ban, the evidence labels or the manifest pointer drifts from this record
rollback.action: revert this record, its validator, its test and the single manifest pointer as one logical shard; nothing else depends on them and no generated node, authority chain or sealed record was touched
